editorial:
Imagine being at the top of your game but living in total fear that some young kid is going to come along and take your spot. That is exactly where you find Halvard Solness. He is a famous architect in Norway who has built the whole town, but he is stressed out and grumpy. Everything changes when a mysterious young woman named Hilda shows up. She claims he made her a promise years ago, and her presence completely shakes up his quiet life and his marriage. It feels like a tense game of cat and mouse where nobody is quite sure who is in control.

You will really notice how the acting makes these old-school conversations feel fresh and spicy. The pacing is steady, though it might feel a bit slow if you usually like big explosions. The best part is watching Solness crumble as his secrets come out. If you are into character studies with a bit of romance and drama, you should definitely give this a go. You can find it for rent on Apple TV or grab the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection if you want the best picture quality possible.
endingExplained: Everything falls apart when Solness tries to prove he is still the boss. He decides to climb the scaffolding of his tallest building to show he has no fear. However, while he is up there, he hears a voice calling him from above. In a shocking twist, he loses his balance and falls to his death. He dies trying to reach a height that was simply too high for him to handle.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological dramas and stories about ego.
